full_judgment: 2. The facts relevant for the disposal of the Rule, in short, is that the land of Baratali Mouja under Mohongonj Upazila of Netrakona District being SA Khatian No. 577 in SA Plot No. 292/293 and BRS Khatian No.250 in BRS Plot No. 502/503 measuring 0.40 acres of land were recorded in the name of the predecessor of the defendant Nos. 1-6 and their predecessors while have been in possession thereof sold the same in favour of the plaintiff and his brother on 3-10-1970 and accordingly the plaintiffs have been owning and possessing 0.20 acres of land and that during BRS, record of right the aforesaid land has been wrongly recorded in the name of the predecessor of the defendants which are mistakenly held and correction of the same is necessary and hence the petitioner has filed Land Survey Tribunal Case No. 580 of 2014 under section 145A of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950. At the time of filing the Land Survey Tribunal Case on 29-1-2014, the petitioner furnished Court fee of Taka 300 and the same was accepted accordingly. The defendants appeared before the tribunal and they by filing a compromise petition on 30-3-2014 accepted the claim of the plaintiff and pursuant to a Solehnama both the parties adduced evidence on 15-9-2014. On 28-2-2016 the learned tribunal accepted the Solehnama, but passed an order to the effect that as per Article 12(ii) of the Schedule-II of the Court-Fees Act, 1870 as amended on 1-8-2008 and coming in to force on 1-9-2010 Court fee would be Taka 1,000, but the case has been filed with the Court fee of Taka 300 only and there remains outstanding Court fee of Taka 700 and directed the plaintiff to pay a remaining Court fee of Taka 700 within 21 (twenty one) working days, failing which the plaint shall stand rejected. The petitioner challenging this order has filed this writ petition and obtained Rule and order of stay.
